text.title: Better Machinery
text.declared_genre: Warm Folk-Hop / Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Soul
text.declared_key: G minor, lifting toward Bb major in final hook
text.declared_mood: Wry, wounded, compassionate, defiant → warm, hopeful, creatively recharged
text.production_notes: Double-tracked fingerpicked acoustic guitar, warm upright bass, brushed snare, soft kick, handclaps, light piano, subtle organ pad, Folk-hop groove, human and roomy, Beat drops before key lines, Final third opens with harmonies and brighter chords, uplifting but still intimate,
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male vocal, Conversational spoken-word rap verses with warm melodic hooks, Dry humor, close-mic phrasing, gentle triplet pockets, occasional sung lines, Starts tired and sarcastic, grows compassionate and confident, Layered soft backing vocals in final chorus,

transcription.text: Funny thing, some people spend all day, guarding the gate, and wonder why, nothing grows in the garden, yeah, I hear you, but listen, I've seen painters turn preacher with the brush in their fists, saying that's not creation, if a tool help with this, then they spend four straight hours in the common section caged on stones and strangers from a fold in chair stage, saying real art suffers, real art bleeds, real art stars and rejects what it needs and I get it, I do, there's rent in the room, there were bills on the table, there were studios closing and people feeling unstable, there were hands that learned to craft, over half of a life, not watching new doors opening, it cuts like a knife, that fear has a name, that fear has a home, but fear can't be the only thing you make on your own, you can curse the new hammer, or build something true, you can shout at the river, or learn how it moves, same hands, same hunger, same old spark under the skin, new tools, new thunder, new ways to begin, you can call me fake from your high little seat, but I'm still making songs, so while you argue with the machine, and honestly, the machine seems less angry, they say probability machine, nothing more, nothing real, as if 100 gets smaller, when you question how it feels, as if meaning is commission from a committee in black, with the clipboard in the headache, in the very pure hat, they play some epic games with the bullet in the chain, say you did the thing, but the name ain't the same, you made the song, but the song doesn't count, you built the door, but she used the wrong mouth, and mighty on the hill, made the doubt telling everyone below them what art is about, but art never cared for the title, you gave it, it just looked for the wound, and a way to translate it, and wow, lay debate, who was clean, who was staying, some kid in the bedroom is making something strange, not purk, not holy, not free of concern, but the laugh in the ends of someone willing to learn, same hands, same old spark on the skin, new tools, new thunder, new ways to begin, you can call me fake from your high little seat, but I'm still making songs, while you argue with the machine, I'm not laughing at the fear I felt to do, the floor moves fast, when the future walks through, nobody wants to be replaced, nobody wants to be priced out, nobody wants to spend years, becoming fluent in the language, then hear the world say, cute, we found a short cut, that hurts, that's real, but hurting people can still be uncrewed, and a frightened artist can still turn into a cop with that posture, there's a difference between protecting the craft and patrolling the borders, so nobody else gets past, there's a difference between asking hard questions and throwing ass in, because someone made art from a different weather, I know the top, every sneer leaves a thumb print, every joke finds a bruise, every fake in the feet, makes the going feel just fine, you start checking the joy like it might be contraband, start hiding the song while it's still in your hands, they're wondering if the thing to save you is the same thing, they'll use to race you and still, something in it just says again, one more draft, I'm gonna take one more little rebellion with a one-base shake, one more chorus, where the doubt can dissolve, one more problem, let the heart one stop, because fight is a match, but one that is cold, one burns loud, one keeps heat in the soul, so let them make passions out of every complaint, I'll make bridges from the park, stay safe, hey, hmm, yeah, same hands, same hands, same hunger, same mold, spark underskid, new truth, new thunder, new ways to begin, you can call me fake from your high little sea, but I'm still making songs, why you argue with machines, same mind, same mind, same fight, same strange road through the rain, new tools, new fighter, rock, wounds, learning their names, if the future is common, then let it come clean, with room for the workers, and the dreamers between, so yes, ask the questions, fight for the living, protect the people whose hands built the room, but don't confuse bitterness for ethics, don't mistake the gate for the garden, and don't spend your whole life calling other people fake, then forget, to make something real, then forget, to make something real
